name: v2.97.0
body:
Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.97.0` with dist-tag `latest`.

## New Features

- Home ocx sync fans out to linked Children (sync.home-fanout/1) (#8100)
- Orchestrated ocx update plan/apply contract (update.orchestrated/1) (#8103)
- Batch consumed stream chunk removal (#8049)

## Bug Fixes

- Show both 5-hour and weekly meters for Max and Team accounts (#8088)
- Place round-robin conversations on accounts with quota headroom (#8092)
- Honest affinity labels and opt-in request-owned conversation affinity (#8080) (#8096)
- Bind header-less Messages bridge turns to one Codex pool account (carry #8028) (#8094)
- Keep Codex pool session pins across proxy restarts (#8098)
- Refuse links at SQLite store paths on Windows and rebalance CI shards for the new affinity tests (#8102)
- Keep Windows containment refusal at 126; correct the #8100 fan-out test fixture (#8106)
- Make the Windows batch shards green after #8103 (#8109)
- Reject inherited writes at Windows creation parents (#8011)
- Preserve quota-code provenance across wrappers and policy fallback (#8013)
- Honor web-search tool choice scope (#8018)
- Scope tool authority to current turn (#8027)
- Bound canonical patch prefix scanning (#8012)
- Serialize automatic v1 reconciliation with CLI updates (#8014)
- Read Artificial Analysis free model list before sunset (#8112)
- Count lowered hosted tool_search as declared (#8123)
- Retire a pool account's carried monthly window when WHAM shows none (#8120)
- Route local compaction checkpoints (#8119)
- Drop the unsupported output.encrypted_content include on Kimi Code Responses (#8122)
- Report prompt_eval_cached_count as cache-read input (#8124)
- Account for normalized inbound JSON (#8026)
- Require paired dashboard session for CLI updates (#8008)
- Export declared effort ladder and default to Kimi Code (#8126)
- Stop sibling discovery after revocation (#8024)
- Answer uncoded context-window refusals as prompt too long (#8128)
- Attest Codex listener before token injection (#8007)
- Report monthly Coding Plan quota (#8077)
- Keep profile keys OpenCodex does not manage (#8074)
- Report content-filter stops as non-retryable refusals (#8072)
- Avoid double charging live NDJSON buffers (#8047)
- Restore owned integrations before native signal exit (#8036)
- Hold selection ownership through dashboard feature toggles (#8009)
- Keep untyped assistant messages inside their tool-call turn (#8064)
- Unwrap one extra executable freeform body wrapper (#8048)
- Resubmit a finished answer on the completion retry (#8070)
- Fix non-ASCII Codex turn metadata headers (#8040)

## Other Changes

- Open dev at 2.97.0 before releasing 2.96.0 (#8068)
- Serve an Ollama-compatible inbound API (#8099)
- Normalize upstream error details in request logs and Retry-After advice (#8104)
- Normalize Chat Completions client error bodies (#8108)
- Promote frozen tip 7b3bb7a257 to main as 2.97.0 (#8134)
